did_you_mean.description: Choices when a name or number matched several records; never merged.
did_you_mean.title: Did You Mean

AuthConfig.description: Public: what the front end needs to start sign-in. Identifiers only, no secret.

message.description: Why sign-in is unavailable, in words.
message.title: Message

AuthConfig.title: AuthConfig

ticket.description: A console session ticket minted by the host owner (live state only); omitted for a dev or fixture identity.
ticket.title: Ticket

redirect_uri.description: Registered SPA redirect URI; null until the app registration has one (sign-in is then unavailable).
redirect_uri.title: Redirect Uri

scopes.description: Delegated scopes to request for this API.
scopes.title: Scopes

message.description: Plain-language sentence safe to show the person.
message.title: Message

check.description: The answer gate's check of this fact.
check.title: Check

note.description: 'What was wrong', in the person's words.
note.title: Note

as_of.description: Oldest capture an answer relies on (ISO).
as_of.title: As Of

count.description: Null when no count may be given (the people exclusion list is not loaded).
count.title: Count

message.description: e.g. '4 more items match, but you don't have access. Ask Purchasing.'
message.title: Message

named.description: False for the unnamed private bucket.
named.title: Named

owner_or_team.description: A shared unit's human label, or the one unnamed bucket for other people's mail, chats and files.
owner_or_team.title: Owner Or Team

data_label.description: Evidence label of the data served, e.g. 'source-mirror captures' or 'FIXTURE'.
data_label.title: Data Label

principal.description: employee:<oid>, or the fixture principals joined.
principal.title: Principal

proof.description: How the identity was proven (entra_access_token, configured_employee, fixture).
proof.title: Proof

hidden.description: Omitted when the source of the list does not count what it hides.
Omitted when nothing counts what is hidden about this record.

people.description: Omitted when no people plan answered for this record.
people.title: People

role.description: What they did on the records: owner, approver, sender...
role.title: Role

handle.description: The L1 citation handle (graph-mail://, api://, bc://, ...).
handle.title: Handle

label.description: Short human label, e.g. 'BC purchase order 90412'.
label.title: Label

open_url.description: Opens the source for this reader; null when it cannot be opened.
open_url.title: Open Url

quote.description: The exact quoted passage, when text.
quote.title: Quote

SourceView.description:
One cited source opened for this reader (``open_url`` of a Source is the app page
``/source?handle=<handle>``, which reads this). Not found reads the same as no access.
SourceView.title: SourceView

info.description: Read-only Workbench API for the web app. Every route but auth/config, auth/dev-login and health needs a signed-in reader. Errors are {error:{code,message}}.
info.title: PLX Workbench app API

post.description: Ask a question; the answer streams as server-sent events.

200.description: Server-sent events. Each event's `event:` is its name and `data:` one JSON object: understanding (UnderstandingEvent), status (StatusEvent), sources (SourcesEvent), token (TokenEvent), answer (AnswerPayload, last), error (ErrorBody, last).

get.description: Public: how to sign in (identifiers only).

post.description: Dev and mock modes only: open a demo session (HttpOnly cookie).
Ends a dev session (Entra sign-out is the front end's MSAL logout).

get.description:
One record's page. ``object_id``: the URL-encoded object id, or a business
reference (e.g. a PO number) resolved within ``object_type``.
A cited source as this reader may open it (a Source's open_url page reads it).
Typo-tolerant autocomplete over the records this reader may see.
